decision: Review required; do not infer speedup from implementation
hypothesis: Capture-only WAL/FULL with bounded checkpoints improves durable capture reader concurrency over SP03a batching; no source capacity claim.
interpretation: Trial-level medians/ranges and paired deltas, not pooled percentiles. Missing/failing outcomes never become latency samples; historical differences are not controlled causal effects.
